# M1-13 — Team Working Agreement

## Labels
`docs`, `milestone-1`, `priority-medium`

## Milestone
Milestone 1 — Engineering Foundation & Requirements Baseline

## Tasks
- [ ] Agree roles/responsibilities (while confirming all members remain collectively accountable)
- [ ] Agree communication channels and meeting cadence
- [ ] Agree branching/PR/review expectations (reference docs/git-workflow.md)
- [ ] Agree how conflicts/disagreements within the team will be resolved
- [ ] Agree escalation process for schedule/scope pressure
- [ ] Sign off the agreement as a team and store it as a controlled artefact

## Acceptance Criteria
- Agreement is specific to this team (not a generic template left unfilled).
- All three members have visibly agreed to it (e.g. commit co-authored, or signed section).
- Referenced consistently by later PRs/issues when relevant.
